description: Product areas for the dbt platform release notes (docs/docs/dbt-versions/release-notes.md). Each area is a #### heading under the month. The order here is the order of headings in a month and of the filter pills on the page. 'links' and 'names' are the docs paths and product names that point to an area, 'constants' are <Constant> names that do the same, and 'st_aliases' are other headings the single-tenant release notes use for it. Areas with a 'featured' number get their own filter pill, in that order; the other areas are listed under the Filters menu.

areas.name: dbt AI and agents
areas.definition: Wizard, Wizard Desktop, Copilot, the dbt MCP server, AI models and providers, and AI billing.

areas.name: Studio IDE
areas.definition: The browser-based editor: file explorer, command panel, editor features, and development settings.

areas.name: dbt State
areas.definition: dbt State and state-aware orchestration: reuse and clone behavior, the dbt State pages, trials, and usage.

areas.name: Catalog
areas.definition: Catalog pages, search, lineage, model and column details, and the Discovery API.

areas.name: Orchestration and run status
areas.definition: Jobs, runs, scheduling, continuous integration, run logs, notifications, and webhooks.

areas.name: Semantic Layer
areas.definition: The dbt Semantic Layer, MetricFlow, metrics, saved queries, and Semantic Layer integrations.

areas.name: APIs, Identity, and Administration
areas.definition: Admin APIs, tokens, SSO, SCIM, permissions, licenses, account settings, billing, and security settings.

areas.name: Announcements
areas.definition: Event sections, such as summit announcements. These keep their own ### heading and are not filed under a #### area.

areas.name: Cost Insights
areas.definition: Warehouse cost and usage data, Cost Insights setup, and cost charts.

areas.name: Insights
areas.definition: Querying, charts, and the Analyst agent experience in Insights.

areas.name: Integrations
areas.definition: Data platform connections, adapters, and Git providers.

areas.name: dbt v2
areas.definition: The dbt v2 engine and CLI (formerly Fusion): engine features, commands, release tracks, upgrading, and the dbt VS Code extension.

areas.name: dbt platform
areas.definition: Anything that doesn't fit another area, such as account-wide platform changes.
